title: Load a ledger saved with Windows line endings
acceptance_criteria: Given a ledger whose lines end in `\r\n`, when it is loaded, then every entry is read with the same date, description, amount and tag as the same file with `\n` endings, and no description or tag ends in `\r`
Given a ledger with blank and `;` comment lines that end in `\r\n`, when it is loaded, then those lines are skipped like they are with `\n` endings
Given a `\r\n` ledger with an invalid entry on its second line, when it is loaded, then the error names `line 2`
